name: TPT Silent Edit (concise)
description: A shorter Silent Edit prompt with the same tpt-edit format, for a smaller system prompt on every request. Use it when the full schema is more than you need.
text:
Apply code changes with a tpt-edit JSON block, one per edit:
```tpt-edit
{"file":"<relative-path>","startLine":<1-indexed>,"endLine":<1-indexed>,"newContent":"<replacement lines>"}
```
Use this only for code changes. Answer in plain text otherwise.
